verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly cover the gateway-choice half of the story: beyond the bundled cards, BACS, checks and cash on delivery, there are 140 region-specific gateways, including Stripe, PayPal, Square and Amazon Pay. Nothing in the pack mentions charging in multiple currencies, whether natively, through WooPayments, or through a named extension. Missing for 10: any evidence of multi-currency pricing or charging, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the gateway integrations.
